verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Bland shipping its own MCP *server* so external coding agents can control Bland (place calls, build pathways, etc.) — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Bland can consume external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Bland's voice agents connecting to or invoking tools from third-party MCP servers; the closest is a generic 'custom API/HTTP endpoint' integration, not MCP-specific.
